items.headline: Gale Watch issued November 14 at 5:02AM CST until November 16 at 6:00PM CST by NWS Houston/Galveston TX
items.area: Galveston Bay; Coastal waters from High Island to Freeport TX out 20 NM; Waters from High Island to Freeport TX from 20 to 60 NM
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, east winds 15 to 25 kt
with gusts up to 30 kt and seas 6 to 9 ft expected. For the
Gale Watch, northeast winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt
and seas 8 to 13 ft possible.

* WHERE...Galveston Bay, Coastal waters from High Island to
Freeport TX out 20 NM and Waters from High Island to Freeport
TX from 20 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 6 PM CST Sunday.
For the Gale Watch, from Sunday evening through Monday
afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
